text:
Chris (CEO): Quick cornerstones update — three priorities for this week: 1) Private GA readiness (security checklist, docs, perf gating); 2) cut p95 inference tail by 20% (runtime/infra); 3) hit $0.40/1k token target for hosted cost play. Readouts Fri 10:00am PT in #exec-brief. Ask: each team lead, post one measurable you can move this week.

Marta (VP Product): Private GA checklist shared in drive: https://drive.redwood.com/priv_ga_checklist — need SMEs for KMS and compliance run. @Lena can you lead the compliance dry run?

Lena (Head of Security): Happy to. I'll schedule a 60m run Wed 2pm PT and invite security + infra. Need list of customer export controls to validate.

Jordan (Eng SRE): Runtime plan to attack p95: toggling continuous batching, KV cache warmup, and a small change to the scheduler. PR #4583 has the batching knob — rolling to staging now.

Jordan (Eng SRE): quick snippet to validate staging latency:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"latency test"}'
```

Marta (VP Product): Also tracking quality regressions — if cost changes require model variant swap, we will gate by eval suite "cornerstone-smoke" (link in docs).

Sam (VP Eng): Good — teams owning routing, runtime, and cache please put a 1-line update in this thread by EOD Tuesday. We'll consolidate into the Fri readout.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/v1.14 -> staging at 2024-05-22T09:30Z :rocket:

Priya (Data & Ops): Cost math update — running simulations shows caching + quantization could get us to ~ $0.43/1k tokens under conservative traffic assumptions. Will post a breakdown by EOD.

Jordan (Eng SRE): rolling to canary now, will monitor p50/p95 and token cost delta.

Chris (CEO): Appreciate the rapid coordination. Two asks again: 1) team leads post single measurable by EOD Tue, 2) be ready to present a 3-slide readout Fri (metrics, risk, blockers). I'll join the readout and want a short backup plan if p95 target misses.

Lena (Head of Security): One note — Private GA docs must include customer key rotation steps. Adding to checklist.

Sam (VP Eng): Noted. Pinging @Marta to confirm customer-facing docs signoff.

Marta (VP Product): Confirmed — docs team will have a first pass Wed EOD.

Chris (CEO): Thanks. Small morale note — shipped 10k dev signups last week, great momentum. :tada: 

Sam (VP Eng): Nice. Quick flag: need a small budget bump for extra dedicated GPUs for private GA validation; emailing finance.

Priya (Data & Ops): I'll model the budget impact and share with finance.

Chris (CEO): Love it. End.
